page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-focused virtual server instance powered by KVM virtualization. It features 52 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding a ratio of approximately 1.85 GB per core.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is not included on this instance type, requiring attached block storage for persistent data requirements. The high vCPU density paired with lower RAM per core offers strong qualitative compute efficiency for processing-heavy workloads that do not require extensive memory capacity or local instance storage.

Primary tradeoffs include the absence of integrated local storage and the lack of bundled GPUs or complimentary public IP addresses. With 52 vCPUs and 16 Gbps network capability, the instance is well suited for compute-intensive tasks, batch execution, distributed compilation, ETL processing, and web server farms.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-focused instance built on KVM virtualization and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor. The server delivers 52 dedicated vCPUs clocked at 2.5 GHz alongside 96.0 GB of memory, resulting in a density of 1.85 GB per core. Network performance features a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps. The instance includes no local storage or attached GPUs, requiring external cloud storage for disk operations. From a resource perspective, the high vCPU count relative to memory provides cost-effective compute capacity for CPU-bound applications that do not demand large memory footprints. Suitable workloads include parallel software compilation, batch data processing, high-concurrency web serving, and distributed computation engines.
